title:
Privacy,
in plain sight.
narration: Shielded payments hide what matters. But public transaction patterns still need context. Ostrakon makes that evidence readable, without asking for a wallet key.

title:
Mainnet.
Inspectable.
narration: Start with real Zcash mainnet data. This recording contains every transaction in block three million, five hundred twenty thousand, fifty four, collected on October sixteenth.

title:
Evidence you
can inspect.
detail:
Tatum Zebra RPC
CipherScan comparison
Committed source records
narration: The source panel identifies the network, collection time, and coverage. Public fields were cross checked with CipherScan. Original responses and checksums are committed on GitHub. This is a snapshot, not live chain verification.

title:
Every record
has a reason.
narration: The timeline retains all seven records. One fits the amount and time rule; six are excluded. Every exclusion has a reason. Eligibility alone never establishes a relationship.

title:
A payout.
Not a guess.
detail:
0.25015 ZEC pool outflow
= 0.25 ZEC public payout
+ 0.00015 ZEC fee
narration: Inspect the real Ironwood exit. The public payout is a quarter of a ZEC, plus a fifteen thousand zatoshi fee. Together, they explain the net pool outflow. Hidden note values remain hidden.

title:
A fee is not
a payment.
detail:
No transparent payout
No invented recipient
No anonymity verdict
narration: Another record exposes only a fee contribution, with no transparent payout. Ostrakon explains the exclusion instead of inventing a recipient. Zero matches in this block do not prove privacy.

title:
A candidate.
Not a claim.
detail:
Amount + time heuristic
Visible supporting records
Ownership unproven
narration: Now switch to an explicitly synthetic example. A dashed connection shows an amount and timing candidate. Supporting records explain why it appeared. This demonstrates the heuristic, not a mainnet finding.

title:
Change timing.
Keep context.
detail:
Original: 1 candidate
Hypothetical: 0
Original data unchanged
narration: In the scenario lab, changing timing removes this candidate. The original dataset stays unchanged. Fewer matches describe this rule's limits; they do not certify anonymity.

title:
Your data.
Your browser.
detail:
Browser worker analysis
No wallet keys or accounts
Local import + report export
narration: Analysis runs in a browser worker. No wallet keys, accounts, or dataset uploads. Import snapshots, inspect the evidence, and export a report you control.

kicker: BUILT BY TECHBONE / OPEN SOURCE / MIT
title:
Make privacy
understandable.
narration: Try Ostrakon, load the recorded mainnet block, and inspect the evidence yourself. Open source, deployed, and built to make privacy understandable.
